newsitem.title: USA: IHOP Corp Q3 net income rises.
newsitem.headline: IHOP Corp Q3 net income rises.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Includes severance charges of $800,000, or $484,000 net of income tax benefit, or $.05 per share.

NOTE - System-wide sales, the retail sales of all International House of Pancakes restaurants, increased 12.4% to $209 million for the third quarter of 1996 and increased 11.4% to $592 million for the nine months ended September 30, 1996, versus the comparable periods in the prior year.
System-wide comparable sales per restaurant increased 2.7% for the third quarter of 1996 and 1.3% for the nine months ended September 30, 1996, versus the comparable 1995 periods.
During the third quarter, IHOP opened 19 new restaurants, bringing the total for the first nine months to 42. IHOP plans to open approximately 65 to 70 new restaurants in 1996.
